conclusion: The exact PyAEZ v2.2 runtime can execute a one-cell maize simulation in an isolated Python 3.11 environment with GDAL, numba and openpyxl. This is an engine smoke test only: it does not close the 23-crop matrix, the ancillary method registry, or the 20,929-location same-geography output contract.

isolated_runtime.creation_command: micromamba create --yes --prefix /tmp/ppc_pyaez_mamba_wave24 --channel conda-forge --override-channels python=3.11 gdal numba pip
isolated_runtime.install_command: micromamba run --prefix /tmp/ppc_pyaez_mamba_wave24 python -m pip install PyAEZ==2.2
isolated_runtime.interpretation: A reproducible temporary runtime is available, but it is not yet a locked project dependency or a production label source. The normal project environment remains unchanged.

failed_alternative_runtime.attempt: uv pip install PyAEZ==2.2 gdal numba in a fresh Python 3.11 environment
failed_alternative_runtime.error: GDAL wheel build failed because gdal-config and native GDAL headers were absent
failed_alternative_runtime.meaning: The failure was an environment/dependency issue, not evidence that PyAEZ cannot run.

smoke_test.purpose: Verify that both water-management methods execute and return finite, non-negative crop yields without treating a failed method as a zero.
smoke_test.geography: One valid 1x1 cell from the official PyAEZ v2.2 Laos tutorial inputs at array index (100,100); this is not an EU5 label.
smoke_test.climate: Official PyAEZ v2.2 monthly min/max temperature, precipitation, shortwave radiation, wind and relative-humidity arrays; monthly values interpolated by PyAEZ to 365 days.
smoke_test.terrain: Elevation 500 m; one-cell mask; latitude bounds 13.87 to 22.59 degrees as in the official tutorial.
smoke_test.interpretation: The paired LRLM/LILM analogue is operational for maize in the isolated runtime. The higher irrigated result is an execution check, not a calibrated historical irrigation fraction or a population target.

crop_parameter_workbooks.scope: crop cycle, biomass/yield and thermal-sum parameters

official_lut_inventory.decision: Do not infer or copy maize/sugarcane parameters into the other 20 registered crops. The inventory confirms the exact reason the crop registry remains unresolved.

sources.title: PyAEZ v2.2 source and official example inputs

next_gate: Promote this runtime only after locking the environment, resolving the ancillary method registry, supplying source-backed parameters for every registered crop, and executing the same footprint sampler for all 20,929 locations. Until then the existing all-GAEZ fallback artifact must remain explicitly a physical_fallback artifact and cannot be relabeled as PyAEZ.
